import socket
import sys

source = '10.40.40.2'

    ('published service', '10.40.40.1', 8443, True),
    ('WAN gateway SSH', '10.40.40.1', 22, False),
    ('WAN gateway HTTP', '10.40.40.1', 80, False),
    ('WAN gateway HTTPS', '10.40.40.1', 443, False),
    ('WAN gateway direct 8080', '10.40.40.1', 8080, False),
    ('direct DMZ service bypass', '10.20.20.2', 8080, False),
]
failed = False
for label, host, port, should_connect in cases:
    sock = socket.socket()
    sock.settimeout(1.5)
    sock.bind((source, 0))
    try:
        sock.connect((host, port))
    except OSError as exc:
        connected = False
        detail = f'{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}'
    else:
        connected = True
        detail = 'connected'
    finally:
        sock.close()
    expected = connected == should_connect
    print(('PASS' if expected else 'FAIL'), label, f'{host}:{port}', detail)
    failed |= not expected
sys.exit(1 if failed else 0)
